item.title: JCS: “North Korea Fires Short-Range Ballistic Missiles Toward West Sea… Under Analysis” (합참 “북, 서해상으로 근거리 탄도미사일 발사…분석중”)
item.description:
The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) announced on the 26th that North Korea fired several short-range ballistic missiles from the Jeongju area in North Pyongan Province toward the West Sea. (북한이 26일 평안북도 정주 일대서 서해상으로 근거리 탄도미사일 등을 여러 발 발사했다고 합동참모본부(합참)가 밝혔다.)

The JCS is currently analyzing the characteristics of these projectiles. If the North Korean projectiles are confirmed as ballistic missiles, this would mark the first launch in 37 days and the eighth of the year. (합참은 이 발사체의 성능을 분석 중이다. 북한 발사체가 탄도미사일로 확인되면 37일 만의 발사이며, 올해 들어 8번째다.)

North Korea previously launched several short-range ballistic missiles from the Sinpo area in South Hamgyong Province toward the East Sea on the 19th of last month. (북한은 지난달 19일 함경남도 신포 일대에서 동해상으로 단거리 탄도미사일을 여러 발 발사한 바 있다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Blue House Moves to Contain Fallout from ‘Kim Yong-beom’s Facebook Post’…“We are Seriously Aware of the Burden on Ordinary People” (또 ‘김용범 페북’ 수습 나선 청와대…“서민 부담 엄중히 인식”)
item.description:
On the 26th, the Blue House moved to manage the fallout from Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom’s remarks that the triple highs (high interest rates, high inflation, and high exchange rate) are an inevitable ‘cost of success’ accompanying the economy’s leap forward, stating, “The government is seriously aware that the current situation could impose a significant burden on small and medium-sized enterprises and the ordinary people’s economy.” (청와대가 26일 김용범 정책실장이 3고(고금리·고물가·고환율)는 경제가 도약하는 과정에서 수반되는 ‘성공의 비용’이라고 언급한 데 대해 “정부는 현재 상황이 중소기업과 서민 경제에 상당한 부담으로 작용할 수 있음을 엄중하게 인식하고 있다”며 진화에 나섰다.)

A Blue House official emphasized that day, “The government is steadily expanding financial support for vulnerable groups, conducting regular monitoring and stabilization measures for the supply and prices of key items, and ensuring stable management of the real estate and foreign exchange markets without disruption.” The official added, “We plan to actively reflect tasks to alleviate the public’s burden in the second-half economic growth strategy and next year’s budget, and we will also establish a response system to preemptively manage anticipated risks.” (청와대 관계자는 이날 “정부는 취약계층 금융지원 확대, 주요 품목 수급·물가에 대한 상시 점검 및 안정조치, 부동산·외환시장의 안정적 관리 등을 차질 없이 추진하고 있다”고 강조했다. 그러면서 “하반기 경제성장전략과 내년도 예산안에 국민 부담 완화 과제들을 적극 반영할 예정이며, 예상 리스크를 선제적으로 관리할 수 있는 대응 체계도 마련할 계획”이라고 강조했다.)

The Blue House issued this stance likely in response to the opposition’s offensive over Chief Kim’s remarks. On the 24th, Kim wrote on Facebook, “Today’s high interest rates, high inflation, and high exchange rate are unavoidable costs of success as the Korean economy leaps to a new level.” In response, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a press conference on the 26th, “Blue House Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom said that the difficulty of making a living is a cost of success, so we need to change our perspective. If the cries of the people’s livelihoods sound like a ‘cost of success,’ then the Lee Jae-myung administration is living in a different world from the people. We must clearly teach them reality in this election.” <<> Floor leader Song Eon-seok also wrote on Facebook, “Even as the people’s suffering grows this much, calling it a ‘process of leaping’ is nothing but a sophistry meant to whitewash the distorted face of failed economic policies. I strongly urge President Lee Jae-myung to immediately dismiss Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, who made reckless remarks disconnected from the people’s lives, and to reset economic policy from scratch.” <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (청와대가 이런 입장을 내놓은 것은 김 실장의 발언에 대한 야권의 공세를 의식했기 때문으로 보인다. 김 실장은 지난 24일 페이스북에 “오늘의 고금리·고물가·고환율은 한국경제가 새로운 차원으로 도약하는 과정에서 불가피하게 수반되는 성공의 비용”이라고 썼다. 이에 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 26일 기자회견에서 “김용범 청와대 정책실장은 먹고살기 힘든 것은 성공 비용이니 인식의 틀을 바꾸라고 했다”며 “민생의 절규가 성공의 비용으로 들린다면 이재명 정권은 국민과 다른 세상에 살고 있는 것이다. 이번 선거에서 현실을 분명 가르쳐줘야 한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Reunification-Related Clauses Removed from North Korean Constitution and Now from Chongryon's Platform (북한 헌법 이어 총련 강령에서도 통일 관련 조항 삭제)
item.description:
The General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) has deleted reunification-related clauses from its platform. <<> The Choson Sinbo, which covers Chongryon's activities and news from North Korea, reported on the 26th that Chongryon held its 26th General Meeting at the Korean Cultural Center in Tokyo, Japan, on the 23rd and 24th, unanimously adopting revisions to its platform and bylaws. A Unification Ministry official stated that the revised platform includes a new Article 6, which no longer contains reunification-related content, and that the revision was finalized on the 4th. <<> In its 20th General Meeting in 2004, Chongryon had adopted a platform stating, "Under the banner of the June 15 North-South Joint Declaration, we will strengthen and develop ethnic unity among Koreans in Japan and ties with North and South Korea and overseas compatriots, reject anti-reunification forces, and devote all efforts to achieving the independent, peaceful reunification of the homeland through a federal system." This has now been replaced with: "We will cherish our language, script, Korean history, culture, and fine customs within the compatriot community, and uphold our national identity across generations through a pan-compatriot cultural movement." <<> Chongryon's platform revision aligns with the same 'anti-reunification' stance as the removal of reunification-related clauses from North Korea's constitution. The revised North Korean constitution, released on the 6th, deleted the content from the former Article 9 that stated, "We struggle to realize the unification of the fatherland based on the principles of independence, peaceful reunification, and great national unity." <<> However, detailed specifics of Chongryon's platform revision were not included in the Rodong Sinmun, a newspaper for the North Korean public. The paper only reported that Chongryon had submitted the revision of its platform and bylaws as an agenda item at the meeting and unanimously adopted it. <<> The Presidium of the Supreme People's Assembly of North Korea sent a congratulatory message to the 26th General Meeting. While Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, sent a letter last December marking the 70th anniversary of Chongryon's founding, urging to "carry on the patriotic spirit of the founding generation to write a great new history of the Korean residents' movement in Japan," this time it was replaced by a message from the Presidium. The Rodong Sinmun reported that Chongryon's First Vice Chairman Pak Gu-ho emphasized the importance of Kim Jong Un's letter from last year, stating, "The direction for the new struggle period is to overcome the current situation of protecting compatriots' rights and interests, ethnic education projects, nurturing new generations, and maintaining national identity within the compatriot community, and to open a new phase of comprehensive development in the Korean residents' movement in Japan." <<> Chongryon also re-elected Chairman Ho Jong-man as the head of its Central Standing Committee at this general meeting and formed a new Central Standing Committee. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (재일본조선인총연합회(총련)가 통일 관련 강령을 삭제했다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae: "Jung Yong-jin's Apology Like Dodging a Passing Shower... Try Harder" (정청래 “정용진, 소나기 피하려는 가식 사과…더 노력하시라”)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 26th regarding Shinsegae Group Chairman Jung Yong-jin's apology to the public for Starbucks' "disparagement of the May 18 Democratization Movement," "I feel bitter seeing this belated apology," and added, "Remember that this cannot end with just a verbal apology." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 26일 스타벅스의 ‘5·18 민주화운동 폄훼’에 대한 정용진 신세계그룹 회장의 대국민 사과에 대해 “뒤늦은 사과를 보며 씁쓸하다”며 “맨입사과로 끝날 일이 아님을 명심하시라”고 말했다.)

In a Facebook post that afternoon, Rep. Jeong wrote, "Given (Chairman Jung's) past far-right remarks and actions, I can't shake the suspicion that this is a hypocritical apology aimed at dodging a passing shower." He added, "A true apology involves responsibility and action. This is utterly insufficient for those who have been hurt. Try harder." (정 대표는 이날 오후 페이스북에 글을 올려 “(정 회장의) 그동안 극우적 언행을 봤을 때 소나기 피하기성 가식적 사과가 아닌가 의심을 지울 수가 없다”며 “진정한 사과는 책임과 실천이다. 상처받은 분들께는 턱없이 부족하다. 더 노력하시라”고 했다.)

Seven minutes later, Rep. Jeong posted again, saying, "I hope Chairman Jung bows his head even lower to apologize to the spirits of the May 18 martyrs and takes more sincere and responsible measures in response to the public anger over his apology." (정 대표는 7분 뒤 다시 글을 올려 “정 회장은 5·18 영령들께 더 머리 숙여 사죄하고, 정 회장의 사과에 분노하는 민심에 더 진정성 있고 더 책임지는 조치를 취하기 바란다”고 말했다.)

Earlier that morning, Chairman Jung said at the Josun Palace Hotel in Seoul, "To the families of the May 18 victims, the families of the late martyr Park Jong-cheol, the citizens of Gwangju, and all of the people who have felt deep hurt and disappointment over this incident, as the chairman of Shinsegae Group, I sincerely bow my head in apology and humbly seek your forgiveness." (앞서, 정 회장은 이날 오전 서울 조선팰리스 호텔에서 “이번 일로 깊은 상처와 실망을 느끼신 5·18 유가족 여러분, 박종철 열사 유가족 여러분, 광주시민 여러분, 그리고 국민 여러분들께 신세계그룹 회장으로서 진심으로 머리 숙여 사죄드리며 머리 숙여 용서를 구한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Even if Jung Yong-jin Apologizes, Can a Country Where the President Says 'Don't Drink Starbucks' Be Tolerated?" (장동혁 “정용진 사과해도 대통령이 ‘스벅 마시지 말라’는 나라, 용납되나”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, took to the streets of Seoul for the first time since the official start of the June 3 local election campaign. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동이 시작되고 처음으로 서울 지역 유세에 나섰다.)

That afternoon, Leader Jang visited Geumnam Market in Seongdong-gu, Seoul, to campaign for Ko Jae-hyun, the People Power Party candidate for Seongdong-gu mayor. The schedule was reportedly arranged at the request of local candidates. (장 대표는 이날 오후 서울 성동구 금남시장을 찾아 고재현 국민의힘 성동구청장 후보 지원유세를 했다. 지역 후보들의 요청에 의해 일정을 잡은 것이라고 한다.)

During his speech, Jang said, "When you compare (Democratic Party candidate) Jung Won-oh, our Mayor Oh Se-hoon hasn't done nearly enough, or rather, too little." He added, "First off, he hasn't beaten anyone up while drunk, nor has he beaten up police officers while drunk." He further attacked, saying, "He hasn't used the May 18 Uprising as an excuse after being ashamed of getting drunk, hasn't built a shaman temple to swindle citizens' money, and hasn't taken a female employee to Cancun." He continued, "The Seoul mayoral candidate backed by Lee Jae-myung will follow Lee's lead and ruin Seoul entirely. Rally your support for candidate Oh Se-hoon so we can see Seoul's development through to completion. You must do that." (장 대표는 유세에서 “정원오 (더불어민주당) 후보하고 비교해보니까 우리 오세훈 시장은 안 해도 너무 안 했다”며 “일단 술 먹고 사람 패는 거 안했고, 술 먹고 경찰 패는 것도 안했다”고 했다. 그러면서 “술 먹고 창피하니까 5·18 핑계대는 것도 안 했고, 굿당 짓고 시민들 돈 빼먹는 것도 안 했고, 여직원 데리고 칸쿤도 안 갔다”고 공세를 폈다. 그는 “이재명이 찍어서 보낸 서울시장 후보, 이재명 따라하다가 서울시 다 거덜낼 것”이라며 “서울시의 발전을 마무리 할 수 있도록 오세훈 후보에게 기를 모아달라. 꼭 그렇게 해주셔야 한다”고 했다.)

Candidate Oh did not join Leader Jang's campaign schedule in Seoul's Seongdong-gu and Mapo-gu that day. Earlier, Oh appeared on Buddhist Broadcasting System (BBS) radio's "Geum Tae-seop's Morning Journal" and said, "The party leader can't just sit still. I told him there would be no place calling him in the metropolitan area, but he's just getting impatient for no reason—there's no need for that." (오 후보는 이날 장 대표의 서울 성동·마포 등 유세 일정에 함께 하지 않았다. 오 후보는 앞서, 이날 불교방송(BBS) 라디오 ‘금태섭의 아침저널’에 출연해 “대표가 가만 있기 어려우니까. 수도권엔 부르는 데가 없을 거라고 말씀드렸는데, 본인이 괜히 맘 급해서 (그러는데) 그럴 이유가 없다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, during the day's campaign, Leader Jang addressed the apology from Shinsegae Group Chairman Jung Yong-jin regarding Starbucks' marketing that allegedly "denigrated" the May 18 Democratization Movement. He said, "Chairman Jung apologized and even took personnel actions against those involved, yet the president and ministers came out and told people not to drink Starbucks coffee—can we tolerate such a country?" (한편, 장 대표는 이날 유세에서 스타벅스의 ‘5·18 민주화운동 폄훼’ 마케팅에 대한 정용진 신세계그룹 회장의 사과를 두고 “정용진 회장은 사과하고 관련된 사람 인사 조처까지 다 했는데도 대통령과 장관이 나서서 스타벅스 커피 마시지 말라 하는 나라를 우리가 용납해서 되겠느냐”고 말했다.)

He raised his voice, saying, "Have you seen the Democratic Party apologize for Daejang-dong, remittances to North Korea, and shamelessly fielding ex-convicts as candidates and committing crimes? Coffee isn't just coffee; it's our small everyday life, our freedom. This violent regime trying to take away even citizens' freedom to enjoy a cup of coffee must be judged in this local election." (그는 “대장동, 대북송금, 그리고 이렇게 전과자들을 후보자로 내고 뻔뻔스럽게 범죄 저지르고 민주당이 사과한 거 보셨나”라며 “커피는 그냥 커피가 아니라 우리의 소소한 일상이고, 우리의 자유다. 시민들의 커피 한 잔의 자유마저 뺏어가려는 무도한 정권을 이번 지방선거에서 심판해야 한다”고 목소리를 높였다.)

Jang Na-rae Reporter wing@hani.co.kr Yoo Young-jae Reporter young@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] Government Plans First Nuclear Submarine to Be Built Domestically by Mid-2030s, Using Low-Enriched Uranium ([속보] 정부, 첫 핵잠 2030년대 중반 국내서 건조…저농축우라늄 사용)
item.description:
On the 26th, the government publicly disclosed for the first time its goal to launch the "first nuclear-powered submarine" by the mid-2030s. It also outlined plans to use low-enriched uranium as nuclear fuel to alleviate international concerns over nuclear proliferation, and to develop and build the submarine domestically. (정부가 ‘핵추진잠수함(핵잠) 1번함’을 2030년대 중반까지 진수하겠다는 목표를 26일 처음 공개했다. 핵연료는 저농축우라늄을 사용해 국제사회의 핵확산 우려를 줄이고, 핵잠은 국내에서 개발·건조하겠다는 구상도 밝혔다.)

President Lee Jae-myung held the inaugural Future National Defense Strategy Committee meeting in Jinhae-gu, Changwon City, South Gyeongsang Province, on the same day to discuss the basic plan for developing the nuclear-powered submarine. President Lee stated, "The nuclear submarine, to be built based on the robust South Korea-U.S. alliance, symbolizes our will to take responsibility for peace and security on the Korean Peninsula ourselves. Furthermore, it will greatly contribute to strengthening South Korea's defense industry capabilities." (이재명 대통령은 이날 경남 창원시 진해구에서 제1회 미래국방전략위원회를 개최하고 이런 내용의 핵추진잠수함 개발 기본계획을 논의했다. 이 대통령은 “굳건한 한-미 동맹을 기반으로 건조하게 될 핵잠은 한반도 평화와 안보를 스스로 책임지겠다는 의지의 상징”이라며 “나아가 대한민국 방위산업 역량 강화에도 크게 기여하게 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Earlier, President Lee and U.S. President Donald Trump had agreed on South Korea's construction of a nuclear submarine during the South Korea-U.S. summit in Washington in October last year. In November last year, the two countries issued a joint statement saying, "The United States has approved South Korea to build a nuclear-powered submarine. The United States will work closely with South Korea, including on fuel procurement plans, to advance the requirements of this shipbuilding project." (앞서 이 대통령과 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 지난해 10월 워싱턴 한-미 정상회담을 계기로 한국의 핵잠 건조에 대해 합의한 바 있다. 지난해 11월 한·미 양국은 공동 설명자료를 통해 “미국은 한국이 핵추진 잠수함을 건조하는 것을 승인했다. 미국은 이 조선 사업의 요건을 진전시키기 위해 연료 조달방안을 포함해 한국과 긴밀히 협력해 나갈 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Accordingly, after seven months of preparation, the Ministry of National Defense announced the 'Basic Plan for Nuclear Submarine Development' for the first time on this day. In a press release, the ministry named the project the 'Jang Bogo N Project'. This name signifies a next-generation model inheriting the spirit of the Jang Bogo, South Korea's first submarine, applying nuclear propulsion, and building a submarine integrating cutting-edge neo technologies. (이에 따라 국방부는 7개월간 준비한 끝에 이날 ‘핵잠 개발 기본계획’을 대내외에 처음 발표했다. 국방부는 이날 보도자료를 내어 핵잠 사업을 ‘장보고 엔(N)사업’으로 명명했다. 대한민국 최초의 잠수함인 장보고함의 정신을 계승한 차세대 모델(Next generation)이며, 핵추진 방식(Nuclear powered)을 적용하고, 첨단 신기술(Neo technology)을 집약한 잠수함을 구축하겠다는 의미를 담았다.)

The Ministry of National Defense stated that the nuclear fuel for the submarine reactor will use low-enriched uranium, and it will be developed with minimal fuel replacement to enable 'long-cycle operation.' Long-cycle operation is a method allowing the submarine's nuclear fuel to be used for extended periods without replacement. Additionally, the ministry explained that the submarine would be developed and built domestically to secure self-reliance and stability in power acquisition, maintenance, and repair. This comes despite President Trump stating on Truth Social on October 30 last year, the day after the South Korea-U.S. summit, that "South Korea will build the nuclear-powered submarine right here in the excellent U.S. Philadelphia shipyard," but the government firmly decided on domestic construction this day. (국방부는 핵잠 원자로의 핵 연료는 저농축 우라늄을 사용하고, 핵연료 교체를 최소화해 ‘장주기 운전’이 가능하게 개발하겠다고 밝혔다. 장주기 운전은 잠수함 핵연료를 오래도록 교체 없이 사용하는 방식이다. 또 전력획득·유지·정비의 자립성과 안정성을 확보하기 위해 국내에서 핵잠을 개발·건조하겠다고 설명했다. 앞서 트럼프 대통령이 한-미 정상회담 다음 날인 지난해 10월30일 트루스소셜에 “한국은 핵추진잠수함을 바로 여기 훌륭한 미국 필라델피아 조선소(필리조선소)에서 건조할 것”이라고 밝혔으나, 이날 정부는 국내 건조를 못 박았다.)

The government also took steps to block international concerns over nuclear proliferation. Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back said at the meeting, "South Korea will firmly maintain the principle of not possessing or developing nuclear weapons," adding, "We have a clear stance of not possessing any form of nuclear weapons and not developing them." Minister Ahn continued, "South Korea will faithfully fulfill its nuclear non-proliferation obligations throughout the process of securing and managing low-enriched uranium, in close communication with the United States." He emphasized that South Korea will establish and strictly implement a safeguards system for transparently managing and supervising nuclear materials for the nuclear-powered submarine, in cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA). Minister Ahn also stated, "All radioactive waste will be thoroughly managed in licensed facilities based on strict safety standards." (정부는 국제사회의 핵확산 우려를 차단하기 위한 노력에도 나섰다. 안규백 국방부 장관은 이날 회의에서 “대한민국은 핵무기를 보유 혹은 개발하지 않겠다는 확고한 원칙을 견지해 나가겠다”며 “어떠한 형태의 핵무기도 보유하지 않으며, 핵무기를 개발하지도 않겠다는 확고한 입장을 가지고 있다”고 말했다. 안 장관은 이어 “대한민국은 미국과 긴밀한 소통 하에 저농축우라늄 확보 및 관리 과정 전반에 걸쳐 핵비확산 의무를 성실히 이행할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 국제원자력기구(IAEA)와 협력해 핵추진잠수함용 핵물질을 투명하게 관리·감독하는 안전조치 체계를 구축하고, 이를 철저히 이행할 것이라고 강조했다. 안 장관은 또 “모든 방사능폐기물은 엄격한 안전기준을 바탕으로 허가된 시설에서 철저히 관리 예정”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Housing prices are rising again—do we have measures?" Orders review of real estate stabilization policies (이 대통령 “집값 다시 오른다는데 대책 있나”…부동산 안정화 정책 점검 지시)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 26th called for another review of measures to stabilize the real estate market. (이재명 대통령이 26일 부동산 안정화에 대한 대책을 다시 한 번 점검하라고 주문했다.)

Chief spokesperson Kang Yu-jung announced this in a written briefing following a Cabinet meeting chaired by President Lee at the presidential office that day. During a closed-door session, President Lee asked, "I hear housing prices are rising again—do we have measures for this?" and emphasized, "Public trust in government policies is crucial," instructing officials to ensure policies for real estate stabilization are in place. (강유정 수석대변인은 이날 이 대통령이 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 뒤 서면브리핑에서 이같이 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 비공개 회의에서 “최근 집값이 다시 오른다는데 이에 대한 대책이 있느냐”라고 물은 뒤 “정부 정책에 대한 국민 신뢰가 중요하다”며 부동산 안정화를 위한 정책을 챙기라고 지시했다.)

Additionally, President Lee directed that in order to strengthen the active stock market, dividends must be returned to stock investors, and a thorough plan for normalizing the stock market should be prepared. President Lee added, "Shifting to productive finance also helps improve the potential growth rate," and stressed, "While statistics are important, we need to deliver tangible results that the public can feel." (아울러 이 대통령은 활성화된 주식시장이 더욱 견고해지기 위해서는 주식 투자자들에 대한 배당이 돌아가야 한다며 주식시장 정상화를 위한 철저한 방안을 마련하라고 지시했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “생산적 금융으로 전환하는 게 잠재성장률 개선에도 도움이 된다”며 “통계도 중요하지만 국민들이 체감할 수 있는 성과를 내달라” 덧붙였다.)

President Lee also urged, "For innovation to be possible, all sectors of our society must be fair, transparent, and objective. I ask the Cabinet members to work harder to make the country shine brightly and become renewed." (그러면서 이 대통령은 “혁신이 가능하려면 우리 사회 모든 분야가 공정하고, 투명하고, 객관적이어야 한다. 나라를 반짝반짝 빛내고 새롭게 하기 위해 국무위원들이 더 힘을 내달라”고 당부했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji: yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Seoul Seosomun Overpass Collapse Kills 2… President Lee Orders "Strict Investigation into Cause of Accident" (서울 서소문 고가차도 붕괴 2명 사망…이 대통령 “사고원인 엄정 조사”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung was briefed on Saturday about the collapse that occurred during the demolition of the Seosomun overpass in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, and instructed officials to "do everything possible to manage the accident and treat the injured." (이재명 대통령이 26일 서울 서대문구 서소문 고가차도 철거 중 발생한 붕괴 사고를 보고받고 “사고 수습과 부상자 치료에 만전을 다하라”고 지시했다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung said in a written briefing that day, "President Lee expressed his condolences to the victims who lost their lives in this accident, and ordered a strict investigation into the cause of the accident, as well as thorough measures to prevent recurrence in the future." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑을 통해 “이 대통령이 이 사고로 인해 유명을 달리한 피해자에게 안타까움을 표하며, 사고 원인을 엄정히 조사하고 추후 재발 방지를 위한 대책도 철저히 마련하라고 지시했다”고 말했다.)

At around 2:32 p.m. on the same day, a portion of the deck collapsed during the demolition of the Seosomun overpass, resulting in six of the seven injured being rescued. Among them, two were found in cardiac arrest and died. (이날 오후 2시32분께 서소문 고가도로 철거 과정에서 상판 일부가 무너지는 사고가 일어나 7명 부상자 중 6명이 구조됐다. 이 중 2명은 심정지로 숨졌다.)

item.title: "Mapo boasts of no major accidents"... PPP's Park Kang-soo's outrageous remarks amid collapse that killed 3 (“마포는 큰 사고 없어 자랑”…3명 사망 붕괴사고에 국힘 박강수 망언)

Park Kang-soo, the People Power Party candidate for Mapo-gu district mayor, was campaigning with party leader Jang Dong-hyuk along Seoul's Gyeongui Line Forest Park in Mapo when he said, "I hear there are many injuries from the collapse at the Seosomun overpass demolition site. This post is no longer visible. He serves as the general situation headquarters chief for the campaign of Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party's candidate for Seoul mayor. <<> Candidate Jeong issued an internal campaign notice with an urgent directive: "Regarding the collapse at the Seosomun overpass demolition site, rescue operations and accident response are the priority. All linking to election campaigns or attacks on opponents are prohibited." <<> Meanwhile, late in the afternoon, Candidate Park Kang-soo issued an apology, stating, "For whatever reason, I sincerely bow my head and apologize to those who may have been hurt by my careless remarks and to all citizens." <<> Earlier, at around 2:33 p.m. that day, the Seosomun overpass, which had received a D-grade safety rating due to aging and was under demolition, collapsed. As the structure fell onto the road below, as of 5 p.m., three people had died, and rescue operations were ongoing. <<> Reporters: Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr, Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (박강수 국힘의힘 마포구청장 후보는 이날 서울 마포 경의선숲길에서 장동혁 대표와 함께 유세를 하다가 “지금 서대문 고가차도 철거현장 붕괴로 부상자가 많다고 한다. 현재 6분이 부상해서 지금 수습 중에 있다”고 전하며 “우리 마포, 4년 동안 단 한 건도 큰 안전사고가 발생하지 않았다는 걸 자랑하고 싶다”고 말했다. 그는 “안전이 제일인데, 우리 마포도 늘 조심해야 될 것 같다”며 이렇게 자평했다. 박 후보는 현역 구청장이다.)

item.title: Jeong Won-oh and Oh Se-hoon suspend election campaigns, visit Seosomun accident site (정원오·오세훈, 선거운동 중단하고 서소문 사고 현장 방문)
item.description:
Following a collapse during the dismantling of the Seosomun overpass in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, Jeong Won-oh of the Democratic Party of Korea and Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party, both candidates for Seoul mayor, temporarily suspended their election campaigns and headed to the accident scene. (서울 서대문구 서소문 고가 차도 철거공사 도중 붕괴 사고가 발생하자 정원오 더불어민주당, 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보는 선거운동 일정을 잠정 중단하고 사고 현장으로 향했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 26th, candidate Jeong stated, “What takes priority right now is swift rescue operations and accident management,” and temporarily halted his campaign to visit the site. At the scene, meeting with reporters, he said, “I hope the number of casualties is minimized and the rescue is completed quickly,” before receiving a briefing from the rescue headquarters. (정 후보는 26일 페이스북 글에서 “지금은 무엇보다 빠른 인명구조와 사고수습이 우선”이라며 선거운동을 잠정 중단하고 현장을 찾았다. 정 후보는 현장에서 기자들과 만나 “희생자가 최소화되고 구조가 빨리 완료되기를 바라는 마음”이라고 말한 뒤 구조본부의 브리핑을 들었다.)

Candidate Oh also wrote on Facebook, “From this moment, I will suspend my election campaign and immediately go to the scene to assess the situation,” and urged, “The Seoul Metropolitan Government and relevant authorities should spare no effort in rapid relief measures.” According to Oh’s campaign, he received a briefing on the accident from the head of the Seoul Metropolitan Government’s Disaster Safety Management Office and requested that all available resources be mobilized to prevent further damage. (오 후보도 페이스북에 “이 시간 이후로 선거운동을 중단하고, 즉시 사고 상황을 살피기 위해 현장으로 가겠다”며 “서울시와 관계 당국은 신속한 구호 조치에 총력을 다해달라”고 말했다. 오 후보는 현장에서 서울시 재난안전실장으로부터 사고 상황을 듣고 추가적인 피해가 발생하지 않도록 서울시의 모든 역량을 동원해 줄 것을 요청했다고 오 후보 캠프가 밝혔다.)

The leadership of each party, which had been in the midst of active campaigning, hastily halted their schedules. Jeong Cheong-rae, acting leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, who was campaigning in Jecheon, North Chungcheong Province, said, “I ask the relevant authorities to act swiftly to ensure no one else is hurt,” and then canceled a planned rally in Andong, North Gyeongsang Province, returning to Seoul. (한창 선거운동 중이던 각 당 지도부도 황급히 일정을 중단했다. 정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 이날 충북 제천에서 선거유세를 하던 중 “관계 당국은 신속하게 한 사람이라도 더 다치지 않도록 최선을 다해주십사 부탁드린다”고 말한 뒤 경북 안동 유세를 취소하고 서울로 복귀했다.)

Jang Dong-hyuk, acting leader of the People Power Party, who received news of the accident ahead of a campaign event in Mapo-gu, Seoul, boarded his campaign vehicle and stated, “Since accident response is underway, we plan to cancel all remaining schedules after today.” He added, “I hope you will listen calmly until the event concludes, and please join me in praying that no more injuries occur.” The People Power Party’s Seoul chapter temporarily suspended election campaigning and performances. Bae Hyun-jin, chair of the Seoul chapter, announced on Facebook, “Until rescue operations are completed safely, the People Power Party’s Seoul chapter will temporarily cease all election campaigning and performances that amplify candidates’ voices.” (서울 마포구 유세를 앞두고 사고 소식을 접한 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 유세차에 올라 “사고 수습 중이기 때문에 오늘 이후 일정은 모두 취소하려 한다”고 말했다. 이어 “유세를 마치고 갈 때까지 차분하게 들어주셨으면 좋겠고, 다친 분이 더 나오지 않도록 여러분께서 같은 마음으로 빌어달라”고 말했다. 국민의힘 서울시당은 서울 지역의 선거 유세와 율동 등을 잠정 중단했다. 배현진 서울시당위원장은 페이스북에 “무사히 구조 작업이 완료될 때까지 국민의힘 서울시당은 모든 후보들의 소리를 높이는 선거 유세와 율동 등을 잠정 중단한다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, upon being briefed on the situation, issued emergency instructions to relevant agencies to prioritize rescue operations using all available equipment and personnel, and to actively cooperate to ensure smooth on-site rescue activities. At around 2:33 PM on the same day, the Seosomun overpass, which had been classified as grade D (poor condition) in a precise safety inspection due to aging and was undergoing dismantling, collapsed, resulting in three deaths and three injuries thus far. (한편 김민석 총리는 관련 상황을 보고받은 뒤 관계기관에 가용한 모든 장비와 인력을 동원해 인명구조를 최우선으로 실시하고, 현장 구조활동이 원활히 이뤄질 수 있도록 적극 협조할 것 등을 긴급 지시했다. 이날 오후 2시33분께 노후화로 정밀안전진단 디(D)등급 판정을 받고 철거 공사 중이던 서소문 고가차도가 무너지는 사고가 발생해 현재까지 3명이 숨지고 3명이 다쳤다.)

item.title: Jeong Yong-jin Bows Head in Apology… Democratic Party Calls It “Dog Apology 2.0,” People Power Party Says “They’re Trying to Take Away Even the Freedom of Coffee” (고개숙인 정용진…민주 “개 사과 2탄”, 국힘 “커피 자유마저 빼앗으려”)
item.description:
Ahead of the June 3 local elections and National Assembly by-elections, the ruling and opposition parties offered sharply contrasting reactions on the 26th to the public apology by Shinsegae Group Chairman Jeong Yong-jin over the Starbucks Korea “May 18 Tank Day” marketing controversy. (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거를 앞둔 여야는 26일 정용진 신세계그룹 회장의 스타벅스코리아 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅 논란과 관련한 대국민 사과에 엇갈린 반응을 보였다.)

Democratic Party of Korea leader Representative Jeong Cheong-rae wrote on Facebook that day, “It’s bittersweet to see Chairman Jeong’s belated apology,” adding, “Given his far-right remarks and actions so far, I can’t shake the suspicion that this is a hypocritical apology to just weather the storm.” He also stated, “Chairman Jeong should bow his head further in apology to the spirits of the May 18 martyrs, and I hope he takes more sincere and responsible measures in response to the public outrage over his apology. Keep in mind that this shouldn’t end with just a verbal apology.” General Election Campaign Headquarters Chief Jo Seung-rae also took a sharp tone at a press briefing, saying, “In terms of the cause of the incident, future prevention measures, and all aspects of content and form, there is no sincerity,” and added, “In a word, this cannot be considered an apology.” Lawmaker Park Ji-won pointed out, “This is ‘Yoon Seok-youl Dog Apology 2.0,’” and noted, “It’s like pouring oil on a blazing fire.” (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “정 회장의 뒤늦은 사과를 보며 씁쓸하다”며 “그동안 극우적 언행을 봤을 때 소나기 피하기성 가식적 사과가 아닌가 의심을 지울 수 없다”고 적었다. 또 “정 회장은 5·18 영령들께 더 머리 숙여 사죄하고, 정 회장의 사과에 분노하는 민심에 더 진정성 있고 더 책임지는 조치를 취하기를 바란다. 맨입 사과로 끝날 일이 아님을 명심하라”고도 했다. 조승래 총괄선거대책본부장도 기자간담회에서 “사고의 원인과 향후 재발 방지 대책 등 사고의 내용과 형식, 모든 측면에서 진정성이 없다”며 “한마디로 사과라고 볼 수 없다”고 날을 세웠다. 박지원 의원은 “‘윤석열 개 사과’ 2탄”이라며 “타는 짚불에 기름을 부었다”고 지적했다.)

However, Democratic Party Daegu mayoral candidate Kim Boo-kyum issued a statement saying, “I respectfully ask the government and ruling party to trust the people and watch this situation from a distance.” On Facebook, Candidate Kim wrote, “The government or political circles must not flow into an atmosphere of publicly pressuring a specific company or criticizing consumption itself.” A Democratic Party leadership official conveyed internal sentiments, saying, “There are opinions that we should wrap it up here, and opinions within the party are divided.” That day, Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon said at a press briefing, “I believe Chairman Jeong’s apology is sincere,” but later apologized when it became controversial, stating, “This was not discussed with the party in advance.” (다만 김부겸 민주당 대구시장 후보는 “정부·여당도 이제 국민을 믿고 지켜봐주시길 정중히 요청한다”는 입장을 냈다. 김 후보는 페이스북에 “정부나 정치권이 특정 기업을 공개적으로 압박하거나 소비 자체를 비난하는 분위기로 흐르면 안 된다”며 이렇게 적었다. 민주당 지도부 관계자는 “여기서 그만 마무리하자는 의견도 있고 내부에서도 생각이 갈린다”고 당내 기류를 전했다. 이날 강준현 수석대변인은 기자간담회에서 “정 회장 사과가 진정성이 있다고 본다”고 말했다가 논란이 되자 “당과 사전에 논의된 것이 아니었다”고 사과하기도 했다.)

The Rebuilding Korea Party issued a commentary that day, pointing out, “He should also apologize for the chairman’s far-right mocking behavior up to now,” while the Progressive Party protested, saying, “Chairman Jeong should stop this ‘apology show’ for face-saving and immediately resign.” (조국혁신당은 이날 논평을 내어 “그간 회장의 극우적 조롱 행위도 함께 사과해야 한다”고 지적했고, 진보당은 “정 회장은 면피용 ‘사과쇼’를 멈추고 즉각 사퇴하라”고 반발했다.)

In contrast, People Power Party leader Representative Jang Dong-hyuk raised his voice all day regarding the ruling party’s movement to criticize and boycott Starbucks, arguing, “We must judge this unruly regime that tries to take away even the freedom to have a cup of coffee.” This is interpreted as a strategy to define the ruling party’s boycott declaration as a ‘deprivation of freedom’ and rally conservative voters by saying, “Only by voting can we protect our freedom.” (반면 장동혁 국민의힘 대표 는 이날 종일 정부 여당의 스타벅스 비판·불매 움직임을 두고 “커피 한잔의 자유마저 뺏어가려는 무도한 정권을 심판해야 한다”고 목소리를 높였다. 정부 여당의 불매 선언을 ‘자유 박탈’로 규정하고 “투표해야 자유를 지킬 수 있다”며 보수층을 결집하려는 전략으로 풀이된다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "We Take Responsibility for Our Own Security"...Domestically Built Nuclear Submarine to Be Launched in Mid-2030s (이 대통령 “안보, 스스로 책임진다”…국내 건조 핵잠, 2030년대 중반 진수)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense unveiled its "Basic Plan for Nuclear-Powered Submarine Development" on the 26th for the first time, aiming to launch a nuclear-powered submarine (nuclear sub) by the mid-2030s. (국방부가 핵추진잠수함(핵잠)을 2030년대 중반까지 진수하겠다는 ‘핵잠 개발 기본계획’을 26일 처음 공개했다.)

Minister of National Defense Ahn Kyu-baek stated at the "1st Future National Defense Strategy Committee" chaired by President Lee Jae-myung at the Naval Submarine Command in Jinhae-gu, Changwon City, Gyeongsangnam-do, that "the first nuclear-powered submarine will be launched by the mid-2030s." The Ministry plans to complete the deployment of the nuclear submarine to the Navy by the late 2030s. This is the first time the government has publicly disclosed its nuclear submarine development plan. (안규백 국방부 장관은 이날 경남 창원시 진해구에 있는 해군잠수함사령부에서 이재명 대통령이 주재한 ‘제1회 미래국방전략위원회’에서 “핵추진잠수함 1번함’을 2030년대 중반까지 진수하겠다”고 말했다. 국방부는 2030년대 후반까지 핵잠의 해군 배치를 마무리하겠다는 계획이다. 정부가 핵잠 개발 계획을 공개한 것은 처음이다.)

Minister Ahn said, "The nuclear fuel for the submarine's reactor will use low-enriched uranium with less than 20% enrichment, and we will develop and build the nuclear submarine within the Republic of Korea." Seemingly conscious of international concerns about nuclear proliferation, he added, "The Republic of Korea will firmly adhere to the principle of not possessing or developing nuclear weapons. In close communication with the United States, we will faithfully fulfill our non-proliferation obligations throughout the entire process of securing and managing low-enriched uranium." (안 장관은 “핵잠 원자로의 핵연료는 농축도 20% 미만의 저농축 우라늄을 사용하고, 대한민국 내에서 핵잠을 개발하고 건조하겠다”고 말했다. 그는 국제사회의 핵 확산 우려를 의식한 듯 “대한민국은 핵무기를 보유 혹은 개발하지 않겠다는 확고한 원칙을 견지하겠다. 미국과 긴밀한 소통하에 저농축 우라늄 확보 및 관리 과정 전반에 걸쳐 핵 비확산 의무를 성실히 이행할 것”이라고 말했다.)

President Lee stated, "The nuclear submarine, which will be built on the foundation of a strong ROK-U.S. alliance, is a symbol of our will to take responsibility for the peace and security of the Korean Peninsula ourselves," adding, "Furthermore, it will greatly contribute to strengthening the Republic of Korea's defense industry capabilities." Following the ROK-U.S. summit last November, the two countries announced in a joint statement that "the United States has approved South Korea's construction of a nuclear-powered submarine. The U.S. will work closely with South Korea, including measures for fuel supply, to advance the project requirements." (이 대통령은 “굳건한 한-미 동맹을 기반으로 건조하게 될 핵잠은 우리 한반도의 평화와 안보를 스스로 책임지겠다는 의지의 상징”이라며 “나아가 대한민국 방위산업 역량 강화에도 크게 기여하게 될 것”이라고 말했다. 한·미 양국은 지난해 11월 한-미 정상회담 결과 뒤 공동설명자료를 통해 “미국은 한국이 핵추진 잠수함을 건조하는 것을 승인했다. 미국은 사업 요건을 진전시키기 위해 연료 조달 방안을 포함해 한국과 긴밀히 협력해 나갈 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

In today's meeting, President Lee repeatedly emphasized the prompt return of wartime operational control (OPCON). President Lee stated, "Through close consultations between South Korea and the U.S., we will complete a specific roadmap for OPCON recovery, including the timing of the transfer." President Lee had also emphasized during a Cabinet meeting earlier that morning, "I hope the OPCON return, which will drive the healthy development of the ROK-U.S. alliance, proceeds without disruption and swiftly." The government has set a goal to regain OPCON from the U.S. by as early as 2027. (이 대통령은 이날 회의에서 신속한 전시작전통제권(전작권) 환수를 거듭 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “한-미 간 긴밀한 협의를 통해 전작권 전환 시기를 포함한 구체적인 전작권 회복 로드맵을 완성해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 오전 국무회의에서도 “한-미 동맹의 건강한 발전을 견인할 전작권 환수도 차질 없이 신속하게 진행해주길 바란다”고 강조한 바 있다. 정부는 이르면 2027년까지 미국에서 전작권을 환수하겠다는 목표를 세우고 있다.)

Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Yoon Suk Yeol is a true hero, chose martial law knowing the hardship"... People Power Party candidate for Gunsan Gap sends long letter (“윤석열은 진정한 영웅, 고난 알고도 계엄 선택”…국힘 군산갑 후보, 장문 편지)
item.description:
Oh Ji-seong, the People Power Party candidate running in the by-election for the National Assembly seat in Gunsan, Gimje, and Buan Gap in North Jeolla Province, has been revealed to have praised former President Yoon Suk Yeol, who instigated the December 3 insurrection, as a "true hero of the Republic of Korea." The People Power Party had singly recommended candidate Oh, calling him "the right person to drive the leap forward of North Jeolla." (전북 군산·김제·부안갑 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 오지성 국민의힘 후보가 12·3 내란을 일으켰던 윤석열 전 대통령을 “대한민국의 진정한 영웅”으로 추켜올렸던 것으로 나타났다. 국민의힘은 “전북 도약을 견인할 적임자”라며 오 후보를 단수 추천한 바 있다.)

According to a video uploaded by candidate Oh on his YouTube channel on the 22nd of last month, Oh said during a dawn service sermon at his church, "Only Jesus Church" in Gunsan, North Jeolla, where he serves as pastor, "If someone asks, 'Who would you visit first if you get elected?' two people immediately come to mind. I want to visit President Park Geun-hye and President Yoon Suk Yeol." (오 후보가 지난 22일 자신의 유튜브 채널에 올린 영상을 보면, 오 후보는 자신이 목사로 있는 전북 군산의 ‘오직예수교회’ 새벽예배 설교에서 “만약에 누가 ‘당선되면 제일 먼저 누구를 찾아뵙고 싶나’라고 하면 두 사람이 딱 떠오른다. 박근혜 대통령, 윤석열 대통령 두 분을 찾아뵙고 싶다”고 말했다.)

Candidate Oh also wrote an eight-page letter to former President Yoon in August of last year and released it on YouTube. In the letter, Oh said, "President Yoon Suk Yeol, you are a true hero of the Republic of Korea," and asked, "How much must you have loved the free Republic of Korea to choose martial law even knowing what hardships would come?" He added, "Some ignorant citizens fail to realize the original purpose of the emergency martial law declared by the President and are caught in the noose frame set by anti-Republic of Korea forces, either remaining silent or siding with them." (오 후보는 지난해 8월 윤 전 대통령에게 8장에 달하는 편지를 쓰고 이를 유튜브에 공개하기도 했다. 편지에서 오 후보는 “윤석열 대통령님, 당신은 진정한 대한민국의 영웅”이라며 “자유 대한민국을 얼마나 사랑하셨으면 어떤 고난이 올 것을 다 아시면서도 계엄을 선택하셨습니까”라고 했다. 그러면서 “무지한 일부 국민들은 대통령께서 선포한 비상계엄의 본래 목적을 깨닫지 못하고 반대한민국 세력들이 쳐놓은 올가미 프레임의 덫에 걸려 침묵하거나 동조하고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

In the letter, candidate Oh also appeared to align with suspicions of election fraud, stating, "Protecting liberal democracy is nothing but rooting out election fraud." In June of last year, he posted on his YouTube channel, "Suspicions of election fraud are continuously raised regarding early voting," and argued, "Until early voting is abolished, you should not vote early." In July of last year, he promoted the "National Rally for Clarifying the Truth of Election Fraud and Nullification" held in Gunsan, saying, "To protect President Yoon Suk Yeol, we must root out election fraud." (오 후보는 편지에서 “자유민주주의를 지키는 것은 오직 부정선거를 척결하는 것”이라며 부정선거 의혹에 동조하는 듯한 모습을 보이기도 했다. 지난해 6월에도 자신의 유튜브 채널 게시물에서 “사전투표에 부정선거 의혹이 끊이지 않게 제기된다”며 “사전투표가 폐지되는 날까지 사전투표를 하면 안 된다”고 주장했다. 지난해 7월에는 군산에서 열리는 ‘부정선거 진상규명 무효 국민대회’ 개최를 홍보하며 “윤석열 대통령을 지키기 위해서는 부정선거를 척결해야 한다”고도 했다.)

Candidate Oh, who uploaded a video "actively supporting martial law" immediately after former President Yoon declared emergency martial law on December 3, 2024, also raised his voice against impeachment. On April 5 last year, the day after Yoon's removal from office, Oh said in a YouTube video, "I do not consider any pastor or anyone who supports the impeachment of President Yoon Suk Yeol as human," and claimed, "President Yoon Suk Yeol, that person was by no means a failure." He also said, "President Yoon Suk Yeol is truly a hero among heroes, on par with President Syngman Rhee and President Park Chung-hee." (2024년 12월3일 윤 전 대통령이 비상계엄을 선포하자마자 ‘계엄을 적극 지지한다’는 내용의 영상을 올렸던 오 후보는 탄핵 반대에도 목소리를 높였다. 오 후보는 윤 전 대통령 파면 다음날인 지난해 4월5일 유튜브 영상에서 “저는 목사들이든 누구든 윤석열 대통령 탄핵을 찬성하는 자들은 사람으로 보지 않는다”며 “윤석열 대통령, 그분은 절대로 실패한 분이 아니었다”고 주장했다. “윤석열 대통령은 정말 이승만 대통령, 박정희 대통령 버금가는 정말 그런 훌륭한 영웅 중의 영웅”이라고도 했다.)

Earlier, the People Power Party's Nomination Management Committee singly recommended candidate Oh for the Gunsan, Gimje, and Buan Gap seat on the 22nd of last month. Park Deok-heum, then chairman of the committee, explained, "Based on his sincerity and dedication to the region, he is the right person to bring harmony among the three cities and counties and drive a new leap forward for the North Jeolla west coast region." Candidate Oh will face off against Kim Eui-kyeom, the candidate from the Democratic Party of Korea. (앞서 국민의힘 공천관리위원회는 지난달 22일 전북 군산·김제·부안갑에 오 후보를 단수 추천했다. 박덕흠 당시 국민의힘 공천관리위원장은 “지역을 향한 진정성과 헌신을 바탕으로 3개 시군의 화합을 이끌어내고 전북 서해안 권역의 새로운 도약을 견인할 적임자”라고 설명했다. 오 후보는 김의겸 더불어민주당 후보와 맞붙는다.)

item.title: North Korea Fires Short-Range Ballistic Missiles and Multiple Rocket Launchers in 'Mixed Salvo' After President Lee's Nuke Sub Reference (북한, 이 대통령 ‘핵잠’ 언급 이후…근거리 탄도미사일·방사포 ‘섞어쏘기’)
item.description:
North Korea launched several short-range ballistic missiles (CRBMs) and multiple rocket launchers into the West Sea on the 26th. (북한이 26일 서해상으로 근거리 탄도미사일(CRBM)과 방사포 등을 여러 발 발사했다.)

The Joint Chiefs of Staff announced that around 1 p.m. that day, they detected multiple types of projectiles launched from the area of Jeongju, North Pyongan Province, into the West Sea. The military assesses that the short-range ballistic missiles flew approximately 80 km, and that multiple rocket launchers were also launched. Military authorities are conducting additional analysis, suspecting that other weapon systems may have been used besides ballistic missiles or multiple rocket launchers, based on the trajectories detected by radar. The JCS stated, "The exact specifications are under detailed analysis by South Korea and the U.S.," and added, "We have also shared information about North Korea's ballistic missiles with Japan." North Korea employed a 'mixed salvo' tactic in this missile launch, likely intended to evade air defense networks and showcase its strike capabilities. This launch marks the first ballistic missile test by North Korea in 37 days and the eighth this year. (합동참모본부는 이날 오후 1시께 평안북도 정주 일대에서 서해상으로 발사된 다종의 발사체를 포착했다고 밝혔다. 근거리 탄도미사일은 약 80㎞ 비행했고, 방사포도 함께 발사된 것으로 군은 추정하고 있다. 군 당국은 레이더에 탐지된 궤적을 분석한 결과, 탄도미사일이나 방사포 외에 다른 무기체계가 사용됐을 수 있다고 보고 추가 분석을 하고 있다. 합참은 “정확한 제원은 한·미가 정밀 분석 중”이라며 “일본과도 북 탄도미사일 관련 정보를 공유했다”고 밝혔다. 북한은 이번 미사일 발사에서 ‘섞어쏘기’ 전술을 사용했다. 방공망 회피와 타격 능력을 과시하려는 의도로 보인다. 북한이 탄도미사일을 발사한 것은 37일 만이며, 올해 들어 여덟번째다.)

North Korea's missile launch was detected shortly after President Lee Jae-myung stated during a Cabinet meeting that he would accelerate the introduction of nuclear-powered submarines. The launch also occurred amid discussions about the possibility of Chinese President Xi Jinping visiting North Korea. (북한의 미사일 발사는 이날 이재명 대통령이 국무회의에서 핵추진잠수함 도입에 속도를 내겠다고 말한 직후 포착됐다. 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 방북 가능성이 거론되는 가운데 이뤄진 것이기도 하다.)

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Park Il said in a regular briefing that day, "We once again urge North Korea to respond positively to our peace policy and efforts to ease tensions." (박일 외교부 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 “북한이 우리의 평화 정책과 긴장 완화 노력에 호응해줄 것을 다시 한번 촉구한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: “Deep responsibility as sitting mayor... suspending all campaign activities” (오세훈 “현직 시장으로 깊은 책임감…모든 선거운동 중단”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, visited the site of the Seosomun Overpass collapse on the 26th and said, “Although my duties are currently suspended, as the sitting mayor, I feel a deep sense of responsibility.” (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 26일 서소문고가차도 붕괴 사고 현장을 찾아 “현재로서는 직무가 정지돼 있지만 현직 시장으로서 정말 깊은 책임감 느낀다”고 말했다.)

After receiving a briefing from the Seoul Fire and Disaster Headquarters and other agencies at the accident site, Candidate Oh stated, “A tragic accident has occurred. An accident that truly should never have happened. From this moment onward, I will temporarily suspend all election campaign activities.” He added, “I have no words to say to the bereaved families of the three deceased individuals. I feel a profound sense of responsibility and offer my deepest condolences to the families.” Candidate Oh learned of the accident while traveling for a campaign event and arrived at the site around 4 p.m., later returning at 5:37 p.m. to deliver this statement. (오 후보는 이날 사고 현장에서 서울소방재난본부 등으로부터 브리핑을 들은 뒤 “안타까운 사고가 있었다. 참으로 있어서는 안 되는 사고가 있었다”며 “이 시간 이후에 모든 선거 운동을 잠정적으로 중단토록 하겠다”고 했다. 그러면서 “세 분의 고인의 유가족분들께는 뭐라 드릴 말씀이 없다”며 “참으로 깊은 책임감을 느끼고 유가족분들께 깊은 위로의 말씀을 드린다”고 했다. 오 후보는 유세를 위해 이동하던 중 사고 소식을 듣고 오후 4시께 사고 현장에 도착했고, 이후 5시37분께 다시 현장을 찾아 이런 입장을 밝혔다.)

Candidate Oh said, “The most important thing is to prevent further accidents, so I have urged the construction personnel and relevant agencies to focus on that. I have also instructed public officials to spare no support for the bereaved families and the injured from this point on.” (오 후보는 “제일 중요한 것은 추가 사고가 없어야 하기 때문에 그 부분에 대해서 공사 관계자분들과 관계 기관에 당부의 말씀을 드렸다”며 “이 시간 이후에 유가족분들과 부상자분들에게 필요한 모든 지원을 아끼지 않도록 공무원에게 요청드렸다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, at around 2:33 p.m. on the same day, the Seosomun Overpass, which had been undergoing demolition after receiving a D grade (critical condition) in a precision safety inspection due to aging, collapsed. The structure fell onto the ground road, resulting in three fatalities as of 6 p.m., with rescue operations ongoing. (앞서 이날 오후 2시33분께 노후화로 정밀안전진단 디(D)등급 판정을 받고 철거 공사 중이던 서소문 고가차도가 무너지는 사고가 발생했다. 구조물이 지상 도로를 덮치면서 오후 6시 현재 3명이 사망했고, 구조 작업이 진행 중이다.)

item.title: Unrepentant Israel… "Completely Denies Detention and Assault of Korean Activists Heading to Gaza" (반성 없는 이스라엘…“가자행 한국 활동가 구금·폭행 전면 부인”)
item.description:
After Korean activists aboard an aid flotilla heading to the Gaza Strip in Palestine stated they were assaulted by the Israeli military, the Israeli Embassy on the 26th issued a statement saying it "completely denies the detention and abuse." This response from Israeli authorities came three days after the Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned the charge d'affaires of the Israeli Embassy in South Korea on the 23rd, urging a thorough investigation. (팔레스타인 가자지구로 향하던 구호 선단에 탑승한 한국인 활동가들이 이스라엘군에 폭행당했다고 밝힌 데 대해 이스라엘 대사관이 26일 “구금과 학대를 전면 부인한다”는 입장을 내놨다. 외교부가 지난 23일 주한 이스라엘 대사관 대사대리를 초치해 “철저한 조사를 촉구”한 지 사흘 만에 이스라엘 당국이 내놓은 반응이다.)

The Israeli Embassy in Seoul released a statement on the same day, asserting, "Regarding the two Korean nationals, contrary to the claims they made after returning home, and as confirmed by the Korean government, they were not detained," adding that it "raises questions about the credibility of their claims of being assaulted." (주한이스라엘대사관은 이날 성명을 내고 “두 명의 한국 국민과 관련하여, 이들이 귀국 후 제기한 주장과 달리, 그리고 한국 정부도 확인한 바와 같이, 이들은 구금된 사실이 없다”면서 “이들이 폭행당했다는 주장의 신빙성에 의문을 더한다”고 주장했다.)

The Israeli Embassy also "completely denied" the activists' claims of physical abuse. (이스라엘대사관은 활동가들이 신체적 학대를 당했다고 밝힌 데 대해서도 “전면 부인”했다.)

In the statement, the Embassy said, "Various serious allegations, including claims of physical abuse (against the Gaza aid flotilla passengers), have been leveled against Israel," and "Israel completely denies these allegations." It also characterized the activists' claims as "part of an attempt to systematically wage a defamation campaign against Israel" and "a deliberate attempt to damage the friendly relations between Korea and Israel." The statement made no mention of the international controversy sparked by the release of a video showing Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir allegedly abusing and mocking activists on the aid flotilla heading to Gaza. (대사관은 성명에서 “(가자지구 구호선단 탑승자들에 대한) 신체적 학대 주장을 포함한 다양하고 심각한 의혹이 이스라엘을 향해 제기됐다”면서 “이스라엘은 이러한 주장들을 전면 부인”한다고 밝혔다. 활동가들의 주장에 대해서는 “이스라엘에 대한 비방 캠페인을 조직적으로 전개하려는 시도의 일환” “한-이스라엘 간 우호적 관계를 의도적으로 훼손하려는 시도”라고 주장하기도 했다. 이타마르 벤그비르 이스라엘 국가안보장관이 가자지구로 향하던 구호선단 활동가들을 학대·조롱하는 영상이 공개돼 국제적으로 논란이 인 것에 대해서는 전혀 언급하지 않았다.)

Earlier, activists Kim Ah-hyun (activity name: Haecho) and Kim Dong-hyun, who were aboard the Gaza-bound flotilla, were captured by the Israeli military and returned to Korea on the 22nd. After returning, Kim Ah-hyun met with reporters at the airport and said, "I was hit in the face several times (by the Israeli military), so my left ear is not functioning well." (앞서 가자지구행 선단에 탑승했던 활동가 김아현(활동명 해초)씨와 김동현씨는 이스라엘군에 나포됐다가 지난 22일 귀국했다. 김아현씨는 귀국 후 공항에서 기자들과 만나 “(이스라엘군에) 얼굴을 여러 차례 맞아 사실 왼쪽 귀가 잘 안 들리는 상태”라고 말했다.)

Yoo Byung-seok, Director of the Consular Safety Bureau at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, summoned Barak Shine, the charge d'affaires of the Israeli Embassy in South Korea, on the 23rd. In response, a Foreign Ministry official said on the 26th, "We conveyed a serious message to the Israeli charge d'affaires on the 23rd and urged a thorough investigation," adding that "if the inhumane treatment is confirmed, there must be corresponding measures." (유병석 외교부 영사안전국장은 지난 23일 바락 샤인 주한 이스라엘 대사관 대사대리를 초치했다. 이에 대해 26일 외교부 당국자는 지난 23일 이스라엘 대사대리에게 엄중한 인식을 전달하고 철저한 조사를 촉구했다”면서 “비인도적 처사가 사실로 밝혀지면 조치가 있어야 한다는 입장”이라고 말했다.)

Kim Ah-hyun and Kim Dong-hyun plan to hold a press conference on the 28th to reveal medical diagnosis results, including physical injuries from the assault. Activist Kim Dong-hyun has stated that after being captured, he was detained on a prison ship for over two days, and until the last day of the deportation process, his hands were bound behind his back while he suffered continuous assault and harsh treatment. He will also provide detailed explanations of the medical diagnosis results supporting this. (김아현씨와 김동현씨는 28일 기자회견을 열어 폭행으로 인한 신체적 손상 등 의료 진단 결과를 밝힐 예정이다. 김동현 활동가는 나포 이후 감옥선에 이틀 이상 구금된 뒤, 추방 절차가 진행되는 마지막 날까지 손이 뒤로 결박된 채 지속적인 폭행과 가혹행위를 당했다고 밝히고 있다. 이를 뒷받침하는 의료진 진단 결과도 자세히 설명할 예정이다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee makes 'surprise visit' to Jagalchi Market… "I washed my hands and waited to shake hands" (이 대통령, 자갈치시장 ‘깜짝 방문’…“악수하려고 손 씻고 기다렸어요”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung visited Busan's Jagalchi Market on the 26th, continuing his on-site communication efforts by meeting with merchants and citizens. (이재명 대통령이 26일 부산 자갈치시장을 찾아 상인과 시민들과 만나 현장 소통 행보를 이어갔다.)

Kang Yu-jeong, Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations, said in a written briefing that day that the President and his wife visited Jagalchi Market and personally purchased natural sea squirts, hairtail squid, cuttlefish, tiger shrimp, sea cucumbers, natural abalone, and Dokdo shrimp using Onnuri gift certificates. The President raised his hand to greet citizens and merchants visiting the market, and citizens responded with "We love you." First Lady Kim also tasted Dokdo shrimp prepared by a merchant and said, "It's delicious." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 서면브리핑을 통해 이 대통령 부부가 자갈치시장을 찾아 자연산 돌멍게와 한치, 갑오징어, 타이거 새우, 해삼, 자연산 전복과 독도새우 등을 온누리상품권으로 직접 구매했다고 전했다. 이 대통령은 시장을 찾는 시민과 상인을 향해 손을 들어 인사했고, 시민들은 “사랑합니다”라고 화답했다. 김 여사는 한 상인이 손질해 건넨 독도새우를 맛보며 “맛있다”라고 말하기도 했다.)

The President and First Lady also took selfies with citizens they met at the market. One merchant reportedly said, "I washed my hands and was waiting to shake hands," according to Senior Secretary Kang. When the presidential couple went up to the second floor, citizens who were eating stood up from their seats to shake hands with President Lee, and one citizen who shook hands exclaimed with joy, "I shook hands with President Lee!" (이 대통령 부부는 시장에서 만난 시민들과 ‘셀카’를 찍기도 했다. 어떤 상인은 “악수하려고 손 씻고 기다리고 있었다”고 말하기도 했다고 강 수석대변인은 전했다. 이 대통령 부부가 2층으로 올라가자 식사 중이던 시민들은 자리에서 일어나 이 대통령과 악수를 나눴고, 악수를 나눈 시민은 “이 대통령과 악수했어!”라고 기뻐하기도 했다.)

The President and First Lady had dinner at a second-floor restaurant with their aides, enjoying seafood and sliced raw fish purchased from first-floor shops. The President complimented the natural abalone he bought on the first floor as tasty and encouraged his aides to try it. (이 대통령 부부는 2층 식당에서 참모진과 함께 1층 상점에서 구매한 해산물과 회로 저녁 식사를 했다. 이 대통령은 1층에서 구매한 자연산 전복 맛이 좋다며 참모진들에게 권하기도 했다.)

The association president seated across from President Lee mentioned that the market was seeing renewed vitality with an increase in foreign tourists visiting Busan, including Chinese tourists, but also noted the still difficult situation and requested support and attention. President Lee expressed sympathy in response. (이 대통령의 맞은편에 앉은 조합장은 중국인 관광객을 비롯해 부산을 찾는 외국인 관광객이 늘어나 시장에 다시 활기가 돌고 있다면서도, 여전히 어려운 상황임을 언급하며 지원과 관심을 요청했다. 이에 이 대통령은 이에 공감을 표하기도 했다.)

item.title: Yoon Suk-yeol-era Broadcasting Commission Duo Lee Jin-sook and Kim Tae-gyu Face Tough Road to Yeouido (‘윤석열 방통위’ 2인방 이진숙·김태규, ‘여의도 입성’ 녹록잖네)
item.description:
Lee Jin-sook (Daegu Dalseong) and Kim Tae-gyu (Ulsan Nam-gu), the People Power Party candidates once dubbed the 'duo' of the Korea Communications Commission during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, are engaged in tight races against Democratic Party candidates in the June 3 by-elections for the National Assembly. (윤석열 정부 시절 방송통신위원회 ‘2인방’으로 불렸던 이진숙(대구 달성)·김태규(울산 남갑) 국민의힘 후보가 6·3 국회의원 보궐선거에서 더불어민주당 후보들과 접전을 벌이는 것으로 나타났다.)

An automated response (ARS) survey of the Daegu Dalseong by-election conducted by Ace Research and Daegu Munhwa Broadcasting Corporation from the 17th to the 18th showed Democratic Party candidate Park Hyung-ryong at 41.7% and Lee Jin-sook at 48.5%. The gap between the two was within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). Similarly, in Ulsan Nam-gu, an ARS survey by Ulsan Maeil Daily and KBS Ulsan conducted from the 22nd to the 23rd showed Democratic Party candidate Jeon Tae-jin at 38.0% and Kim Tae-gyu at 39.9%, also within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). For details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. ( 에이스리서치·대구문화방송이 지난 17∼18일 실시한 대구 달성 국회의원 보궐선거 무선 자동응답(ARS) 조사를 보면 박형룡 민주당 후보는 41.7%, 이진숙 후보 48.5%를 기록했다. 두 사람의 격차는 오차범위(±4.4%포인트) 안에 있었다. 울산 남갑 역시 울산매일신문·한국방송울산의 22∼23일 무선 자동응답 조사에서 전태진 민주당 후보 38.0%, 김태규 후보 39.9%의 지지율을 기록해, 격차는 오차범위(±4.4%포인트) 안이었다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다.)

Both districts are traditionally considered strongholds for the People Power Party. Daegu Dalseong, where Lee is running, was the constituency of same-party Daegu mayoral candidate Chu Kyung-ho and is home to former President Park Geun-hye’s private residence. Chu won the 2024 general election with 75.3% support. Similarly, Ulsan Nam-gu was won by then-People Power Party member Kim Sang-wook (now the Democratic Party's Ulsan mayoral candidate) in the 2024 general election with 53.8% of the vote. ( 두곳은 모두 국민의힘 우세 지역으로 분류되는 곳이다. 이 후보가 나선 대구 달성군은 같은 당 추경호 대구시장 후보의 지역구였고, 박근혜 전 대통령의 사저가 있는 곳이다. 추 후보는 2024년 총선에서 75.3% 지지로 당선됐다. 울산 남갑 역시 2024년 총선 때 당시 국민의힘 소속이던 김상욱 의원(현 더불어민주당 울산시장 후보)이 53.8%를 얻어 당선된 곳이다.)

Political circles suggest this is due to the hardline conservative, 'Yoon again' image of candidates Lee Jin-sook and Kim Tae-gyu. Both have sparked controversy since their nominations with remarks such as "Is 'Yoon again' a criminal?" (Lee) and "It’s hasty to definitively say the martial law was illegal" (Kim). ( 정치권 주변에서는 이진숙 후보와 김태규 후보의 강성 보수, 윤 어게인 이미지 때문이라는 말이 나온다. 두 후보는 공천 당시부터 “윤 어게인이 범죄자냐”(이진숙), “비상계엄은 섣불리 위법하다고 단정하기 어렵다”(김태규)는 발언으로 논란을 빚었다. )

A Democratic Party lawmaker from the Yeongnam region said, "I believe the backlash against candidate Kim Tae-gyu, who calls for 'Yoon again,' has significantly impacted the race." Candidate Park Hyung-ryong told the Hankyoreh, "In the Daegu region, there is criticism of Lee Jin-sook’s parachute nomination and an aversion to her hardline remarks." Lee initially ran in the People Power Party’s Daegu mayoral primary but was excluded from the nomination. After disputing her exclusion, she was nominated as the candidate for the Dalseong by-election. A People Power Party lawmaker from the Yeongnam region also said, "Candidate Lee Jin-sook, who has a history of hardline remarks in the region, is unpopular. Even if she wins, it will be by a narrow margin." However, a source from Lee Jin-sook’s campaign said, "These surveys were conducted immediately after candidate registration, when the candidate was not well-known. The gap has since widened significantly." ( 영남권의 한 민주당 의원은 “‘윤 어게인’을 외치는 김태규 후보에 대한 반감이 판세에 큰 영향을 미쳤다고 본다”고 말했다. 박형룡 후보는 한겨레에 “대구 지역에는 이진숙 후보의 낙하산 공천에 대한 원성이 있고, 강성 발언에 대한 기피감도 있는 것으로 이해한다”고 했다. 이 후보는 애초 국민의힘 대구시장 경선에 나섰다가 공천 배제됐다. 그는 공천 배제에 불복하다가 달성 국회의원 보궐선거 후보로 공천받았다. 한 영남권 국민의힘 의원 역시 “지역에서 강성 발언을 일삼아온 이진숙 후보는 인기 없다. 이긴다 한들 간신히 이길 것”이라고 말했다. 다만 이진숙 후보 캠프 관계자는 “후보 등록 직후 후보가 잘 알려지지 않은 상태에서 실시된 조사들이다. 지금은 차이를 많이 벌렸다”고 말했다.)

Reporters Kim Hae-jeong, Jung Hye-min, and Ko Han-sol sea@hani.co.kr ( 김해정 정혜민 고한솔 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Pushing forward with '32-year secret' nuclear submarine project publicly, aiming for a speed race 'within Trump's term' (‘32년 비밀’ 핵잠사업 공개 추진…‘트럼프 임기내’ 속도전 노려)
item.description:
The government announced its goal to build and launch the first nuclear-powered submarine domestically by the mid-2030s, and to deploy it to front-line naval units by the late 2030s. However, there are many tasks to coordinate with the United States, such as securing nuclear fuel, leading to observations that future practical discussions may not be smooth. (정부가 2030년대 중반까지 첫 핵추진잠수함(핵잠)을 국내에서 건조해 진수하고 2030년대 후반에는 해군 일선부대에 배치한다는 목표를 밝혔다. 다만 핵연료 확보 등 미국과 협의해야 할 과제가 적지 않아 향후 실무 논의가 순탄하지 않을 것이란 관측이 나온다.)

Minister of National Defense Ahn Kyu-baek reported the basic plan for nuclear submarine development, the 'Jangbogo N Project,' at the '1st Future National Defense Strategy Committee' held at the Navy Submarine Command in Jinhae, South Gyeongsang Province, on the 26th, in the presence of President Lee Jae-myung. The 'Jangbogo N Project' refers to a project to build a submarine that inherits the spirit of the Jangbogo, Korea's first submarine, applies a nuclear-powered method to a next-generation model, and integrates cutting-edge new technologies. <<> Minister Ahn stated that the nuclear submarine will "play a key role in preparing against North Korea's submarine-based nuclear missile threats" and "contribute significantly to implementing an underwater kill chain, as it can monitor and track North Korean submarine forces more covertly and quickly than diesel submarines." <<> Military authorities are known to be reviewing a plan to build at least four nuclear submarines. Minister Ahn said, "We will develop and build nuclear submarines within the Republic of Korea." The plan involves producing the nuclear submarine platform (hull) and propulsion system (small nuclear reactor) domestically, while securing nuclear fuel for the reactor with U.S. assistance. <<> On this day, the government announced the basic plan, converting the nuclear submarine development, which had been pursued in secret for 32 years, into a public project. This shift to a public project can be seen as targeting both the alleviation of concerns about South Korea's nuclear armament and a push to solidify progress within the term of U.S. President Donald Trump. <<> Nuclear submarine development, which began in 1994 under the Kim Young-sam administration, has repeatedly been pursued and stalled over 32 years. The biggest obstacle has been U.S. concerns that "South Korea could arm itself with nuclear weapons." South Korea needs to receive nuclear fuel from the U.S. for the small nuclear reactor, the propulsion engine of the nuclear submarine, to operate it. Since the existing South Korea-U.S. Nuclear Agreement is based on civilian use, a separate agreement is needed to secure enriched uranium for military purposes. Article 91 of the U.S. Atomic Energy Act includes an exception clause allowing the transfer of nuclear materials for military use to other countries with presidential approval. Up until the release of the joint explanatory document last November, South Korea and the U.S. were tugging over this issue. As a result, observations suggest that future practical consultations will not be smooth. <<> Through the basic plan, South Korea has repeatedly emphasized that it will not build a strategic submarine carrying nuclear weapons, but rather a submarine armed with conventional weapons like torpedoes. The government's inclusion of a 'commitment' to transparently and firmly fulfill nuclear non-proliferation obligations in the basic plan is also aimed at dispelling concerns about South Korea's nuclear armament. The basic plan stated the fundamental position of 'not possessing any form of nuclear weapons and not developing nuclear weapons.' It further specified that "the Republic of Korea will jointly establish a safeguards system applicable to nuclear-powered submarines with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and fulfill a high level of nuclear non-proliferation obligations." South Korea plans to use low-enriched uranium at 20% or less, which cannot be used for nuclear weapons at all. <<> The announcement of the basic plan also has an aspect of speeding up the nuclear submarine project within the Trump administration's term. After the South Korea-U.S. summit agreement last October, follow-up consultations on nuclear submarines between the two countries have been delayed due to pending issues such as the Coupang problem and delays in implementing investments in the U.S. Accordingly, the government's intent is to preemptively announce the basic plan to accelerate the pace of nuclear submarine development. <<> Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Nam-il namfic@hani.co.kr ( 안규백 국방부 장관은 26일 이재명 대통령이 참석한 가운데 경남 진해 해군잠수함사령부에서 열린 ‘제1회 미래국방전략위원회’에서 핵잠 개발 기본계획인 ‘장보고 엔(N)사업’을 보고했다. ‘장보고 엔사업’은 대한민국 최초의 잠수함인 장보고함의 정신을 계승한 차세대 모델(Next generation)에 핵추진 방식(Nuclear powered)을 적용해 첨단 신기술(Neo technology)을 집약한 잠수함을 구축하겠다는 사업을 뜻한다.)

item.title: Amid Differences Between South Korea and U.S. on Wartime Operational Control (OPCON) Transition Timing, President Lee Says "Defending Ourselves Is the Foundation of the Nation" (한미 ‘전작권 전환’ 시기 이견 속 이 대통령 “스스로 지키는 게 국가의 근본”)
item.description:
On the 26th, President Lee Jae-myung emphasized the swift return of wartime operational control (OPCON) during a Cabinet meeting and the 1st Future Defense Strategy Committee. This reaffirmed his commitment to reclaiming OPCON, even as there has been a temperature difference between South Korea and the U.S. regarding the timing of the transition. (이재명 대통령이 26일 국무회의와 제1회 미래국방전략위원회에서 거듭 신속한 전시작전통제권(전작권) 환수를 강조했다. 최근 전작권 전환 시기를 둘러싼 한-미 간 온도 차가 있는 가운데 환수 의지를 다시 확인한 것이다.)

At the "1st Future Defense Strategy Committee" held at the Naval Submarine Command in Jinhae-gu, Changwon City, South Gyeongsang Province, President Lee stressed that recovering OPCON is a "core element of self-reliant national defense" and emphasized that a specific roadmap for the OPCON recovery would be completed through consultations between South Korea and the U.S. (이 대통령은 이날 경남 창원시 진해구에 있는 해군잠수함사령부에서 열린 ‘제1회 미래국방전략위원회’에서 전작권 회복이 “자주국방의 핵심 요소”임을 강조하며, 한-미 간 협의를 통해 구체적인 전작권 회복 로드맵을 완성해나가겠다고 강조했다.)

During the meeting, Minister of National Defense Ahn Gyu-back presented a detailed roadmap. Minister Ahn stated, "The Republic of Korea possesses strong military power, but among the approximately 190 countries in the world, it is the only one without wartime operational control," adding, "After completing verification of the Full Operational Capability (FOC) related to the mission performance capability of the future Combined Forces Command (following the OPCON transition) this year, I will propose the timing of the OPCON transition to the President to make the recovery of OPCON a reality." (안규백 국방부 장관은 이날 회의에서 구체적인 로드맵을 제시했다. 안 장관은 “대한민국은 강력한 군사력을 보유하고 있지만, 전세계 190여개 나라 중 전작권이 없는 유일무이한 국가”라며 “올해 (전작권 전환 이후 전작권을 행사할 미래연합사령부의 임무수행능력과 관련해) 완전운용능력(FOC)에 대한 검증을 마친 뒤 대통령께 전작권 시기를 건의해 전작권 회복을 가시화하도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

South Korea and the U.S. completed the first stage, Initial Operational Capability (IOC), evaluation and verification for the future Combined Forces Command in 2019 and 2020, respectively. The second stage, Full Operational Capability (FOC) evaluation, was completed in 2022, and it is scheduled to be verified at the 58th South Korea-U.S. Annual Security Consultative Meeting this fall. The defense ministers of South Korea and the U.S. will eventually propose a transition date to the presidents of both countries after completing the third stage, Full Mission Capability (FMC) evaluation and verification. (한·미는 미래연합사령부에 대해 1단계인 기본운용능력(IOC) 평가와 검증을 각각 2019년과 2020년 마쳤다. 2단계인 완전운용능력 평가는 2022년 마쳤고, 올해 가을 열리는 제58차 한-미 연례안보협의회의에서 이를 검증할 계획이다. 한·미 국방장관은 3단계인 완전임무수행능력(FMC) 평가·검증까지 끝낸 뒤 한·미 대통령에게 전환 일자를 건의하게 된다.)

President Lee's remarks draw attention because South Korea and the U.S. recently showed subtle differences in views regarding the timing of the OPCON transition. The Ministry of National Defense predicts that if consultations between South Korea and the U.S. proceed smoothly, the return of OPCON could be possible as early as late 2027. However, U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) Commander General Xavier Brunson proposed the timing of the OPCON transition as the first quarter of 2029 during a hearing before the U.S. House Armed Services Committee on April 22 (local time). Since last year, General Brunson has repeatedly emphasized in various public forums that what matters in the OPCON transition is not the timing but the fulfillment of conditions. (이 대통령의 발언이 주목받는 이유는 최근 전작권 전환 시기를 두고 한·미가 미묘한 견해차를 노출했기 때문이다. 국방부는 한-미 간 협의가 원활하게 이뤄질 경우 이르면 2027년 말께 전작권 환수가 가능할 것이라고 전망한다. 그러나 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관은 지난 4월22일(현지시각) 미국 하원 군사위원회에서 전작권 전환 시기를 2029년 1분기로 제시했다. 지난해부터 브런슨 사령관은 각종 공개 석상에서 전작권 전환에서 중요한 것은 시기가 아니라 조건 충족이라고 거듭 강조하고 있다.)

The South Korean government explains that the timing of the OPCON return falls within the realm of political decisions by the leaders of both countries. On the 17th, regarding General Brunson's remarks, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac indirectly rebutted by stating, "This is an issue that can be addressed at the level of dialogue between heads of state or at a high-level meeting representing the heads of state." (한국 정부는 전작권 환수 시기는 양국 대통령의 정치적 결정 영역에 있다고 설명한다. 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 지난 17일 브런슨 사령관의 발언에 관해 “정상 간의 또는 정상을 대변할 수 있는 고위급 대화 차원에서 다뤄질 수 있는 문제”라고 에둘러 반박했다.)

During the meeting, when Minister Ahn said, "Even if OPCON were returned tomorrow, there would be no significant problem in defending ourselves," President Lee emphasized, "It's not that there's a big problem; it would be more accurate to say there is no problem at all." In his closing remarks, President Lee also stated, "In the field of national defense, it seems that a lot of dependent thinking still remains," adding, "Defending oneself with one's own strength is the foundation of a nation." (이날 안 장관이 “내일 전작권이 회수되더라도 (우리를) 스스로 지키는 데 크게 문제가 없다”고 말하자, 이 대통령은 “크게 문제가 있는 게 아니라 아무 문제가 없다고 해야 맞다”고 강조하기도 했다. 이 대통령은 마무리 발언에서도 “국방 분야에 있어서는 여전히 의존적 사고가 많이 남아 있는 거 같다”며 “스스로의 힘으로 스스로를 지킨다는 건 국가의 근본”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ulsan mayor candidacy unification between Democratic and Progressive parties faces collapse... Kim Sang-uk belatedly demands 'anti-strategic voting' measure (민주·진보 울산시장 후보 단일화 무산 위기…김상욱, 뒤늦게 ‘역선택 방지’ 요구)
item.description:
With three days left until early voting for the June 3 local elections, the unification of Ulsan mayor candidates between Kim Sang-uk of the Democratic Party of Korea and Kim Jong-hoon of the Progressive Party is on the verge of collapse. The two parties initially agreed not to include an 'anti-strategic voting clause' in the unification opinion poll, but the Democratic Party requested a redo of the poll with an anti-strategic voting mechanism in place, halting the primary. The Progressive Party maintains that the unification poll should be resumed as previously agreed. <<> Candidate Kim Sang-uk held a press conference at his election office in Nam-gu, Ulsan, on the 26th, saying, "I only found out after the opinion poll started that there was no anti-strategic voting mechanism," and proposed restarting the primary poll with an anti-strategic voting clause included. He cited evidence of interference in the poll by supporters of the People Power Party. <<> However, the 'Ulsan Mayor Unification Opinion Poll Agreement' between the two parties, released by Candidate Kim Jong-hoon's side, did not originally include an anti-strategic voting clause. Candidate Kim Sang-uk's side attributed this to "strong demands from the Progressive Party." In contrast, Bang Seok-su, chairman of the Progressive Party's Ulsan city chapter, said, "That's completely untrue," adding, "We agreed on the competition method, and now that the competition is almost over, they realize they're at a disadvantage and want to start over—how convincing is that?" <<> The Progressive Party pointed out that Candidate Kim Sang-uk's side, after checking interim poll results, may have halted the primary under the pretext of 'external interference' due to concerns about unfavorable outcomes. Shin Chang-hyeon, secretary-general of the Progressive Party, said, "On the 24th, the first day of the poll, a contact from Candidate Kim Sang-uk's side called the Progressive Party's person in charge, citing specific figures and insisting that the survey should be stopped," raising allegations of premature disclosure of poll results. Candidate Kim Sang-uk's side countered, "We didn't see specific figures. item.title: Two Days Until Early Voting... Democratic Party Says "Close Races in 6 Regions Including Busan and Daegu," People Power Party Claims "Beyond the Golden Cross in Yeongnam" (사전투표 D-2…민주 “부산·대구 등 6곳 접전” 국힘 “영남 골든크로스 넘어”)
item.description:
On the 26th, three days before the June 3 local elections' early voting period (May 29-30), analysis suggests the election landscape is becoming foggy as regions previously considered strongholds for the Democratic Party of Korea are turning into tight contests. With the Democratic Party pushing for a special counsel bill to investigate alleged election rigging, the ruling and opposition parties' support bases have become firmly entrenched. Additionally, starting from the 28th until the close of voting on election day, the publication of opinion polls is banned, making it difficult for both parties to predict the direction of late-deciding voters. <<> Cho Seung-rae, the general election campaign chief of the Democratic Party of Korea, held a press briefing at the National Assembly on the same day. Regarding the race for metropolitan mayors and governors, he stated, "Close battles are underway in Seoul, Busan, Daegu, Ulsan, South Gyeongsang Province, and North Jeolla Province," adding, "Our goal is to win as many of these six competitive regions as possible." He assessed that the party is "stably leading" in nine other areas—Incheon, Gyeonggi Province, Gangwon Province, Daejeon, Sejong, South Chungcheong Province, North Chungcheong Province, Gwangju/South Jeolla Province, and Jeju Island—but frankly acknowledged, "We have to admit that the People Power Party is stably leading in North Gyeongsang Province." <<> In the highly anticipated Daegu mayoral race, for instance, Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party candidate, was initially expected to make a strong showing about a month ago. However, as election day approaches, People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho has mounted a rapid comeback, turning it into an ultra-tight contest. According to a poll conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on May 24-25 for CBS, Choo Kyung-ho's approval rating stood at 50.1%, leading Kim Boo-kyum (41.1%) by 9.0 percentage points, outside the margin of error (±3.1 percentage points) in the wireless phone survey on Daegu mayoral support. In North Jeolla Province, a traditionally strong area for the Democratic Party, independent candidate Kim Gwan-young—who was expelled from the party over the so-called "money envelope scandal"—is ahead of Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek, according to a poll. The New Jeonbuk Daily-Hangil Research survey on provincial governor support in North Jeolla (via wireless phone) showed Kim Gwan-young at 47.3%, leading Lee Won-taek (38.7%) outside the margin of error (±3.1 percentage points). (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) <<> The Democratic Party is focusing its efforts on rallying its support base. "Elections always involve an opponent. When conservatives consolidate, Democratic Party supporters and presidential supporters also consolidate," Cho said. "Making that happen is the main goal of our campaign." A Democratic Party official elaborated to *The Hankyoreh*, saying, "In Seoul, we believe the outcome could vary depending on the voter turnout." <<> The People Power Party believes the situation is turning in its favor as conservative voters consolidate in the final stretch. Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk held a press briefing at the National Assembly, stating, "A firm belief that we cannot be deprived of our freedom is coming together," and "A strong will to protect our homes and property is changing the election landscape." People Power Party Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook appeared on CBS's "Park Sung-tae's News Show" and said, "We believe many regions in the Yeongnam area have surpassed the golden cross. We also see significant possibilities in Seoul, Gangwon Province, and the Chungcheong regions." <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan: chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Cho Hee-yeon: choh@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Han-sol: sol@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거 사전투표일(29~30일)을 사흘 앞둔 26일, 더불어민주당 우세로 여겨지던 지역들이 접전 양상으로 돌아서면서 선거 판세가 안갯속에 빠져들었다는 분석이 나온다. 민주당의 조작기소 특검법안 추진 등으로 여야 지지층이 팽팽하게 결집한 가운데 오는 28일부터 선거일 투표 마감 시각까지 여론조사 공표가 금지됨에 따라, 여야 모두 막판 표심의 향방을 장담하기 어렵게 됐다.)

item.title: Kim Min-jeon's Explanation of "Oppa" Remark Sparks Criticism: "Consideration? It's Hypocrisy" (“오빠 발언, 편하게 지나가라고…” 김민전 해명에 “배려? 내로남불” 비판)
item.description:
Kim Min-jeon, a lawmaker from the People Power Party (PPP), drew criticism from the Justice Party for explaining that her remark to early teenage girls during a campaign rally for Byun Jae-il’s by-election in Busan’s Buk-gu district—"There are many handsome oppas here"—was made out of consideration for the girls. The Justice Party argued that this hypocrisy in politics is unbearable. They pointed out that Kim and the PPP had harshly criticized Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae and Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo earlier this month over their own "oppa" remarks, yet now they are trying to justify their own similar comment as "consideration." <<> On the 26th, the Justice Party issued a statement saying, "Forcing young students to call adult men 'oppa' and imposing intimacy is itself an outdated gender stereotype behavior." <<> Earlier, on the 25th, Kim took to the streets with candidate Park in Busan’s Manduk-dong area for a campaign event. During this, about eight girls estimated to be in their early teens tried to pass by the campaign spot, which was being livestreamed on YouTube by Park. The narrow street was crowded with Kim, Park, and men holding cameras on both sides. As the girls hesitated to pass, Kim waved at them and said, "Hello. There are many handsome oppas here." Then, a man holding a camera said in a casual tone, "Just go, it's fine." The girls, seemingly aware of the camera, covered their faces with their phones and quickly walked past Kim and Park. <<> After media reports sparked controversy, Kim took to Facebook to explain. She stated, "There were about 10 men who looked to be in their 20s at the scene, and the girls couldn't get through, so I said it to encourage them not to be scared and to pass freely." She added, "It's being reported as if I called Candidate Park 'oppa,' but I never did that." Kim also referenced the controversy over Ha’s "oppa" remark, saying, "Unlike someone, I never forced them to call me 'oppa.'" <<> In response, the Justice Party criticized, "Kim explained that she wasn't referring to Candidate Park, but do you think that's a valid explanation?" Regardless of whether Park was addressed, they argued the remark was "inappropriate." <<> The Justice Party then pointed out the PPP’s double standards. They said, "Just weeks ago, the PPP fiercely criticized Ha's 'oppa' controversy, calling it 'child abuse,' 'sexual harassment,' and a 'lack of gender sensitivity,' even using the term 'oppa coercion offender.' But when their own lawmaker repeats the same behavior, they try to gloss over their poor gender sensitivity under the guise of 'consideration.'" <<> The Justice Party urged the PPP to "apply the same harsh criticism they dished out to themselves" and emphasized, "We can no longer tolerate the hypocrisy of calling it consideration when they do it, but sexual harassment when others do it." Regarding Kim's comment about not forcing anyone to call her 'oppa' "unlike someone," they added, "When a problem arises, the proper response is immediate reflection and an apology, not blaming others by saying 'unlike someone.' That's the current standard of the PPP." <<> The Justice Party, which had previously urged Ha to reflect on his lack of gender sensitivity and apologize to the public over his 'oppa' comment, now said, "The same goes for Kim Min-jeon. Don't package this as 'consideration'; apologize to the public." They added, "Both the PPP and the Democratic Party should acknowledge their lack of gender sensitivity and conduct checks on this issue." <<> Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (김민전 국민의힘 의원이 박민식 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세 도중 10대 초반 여학생들에게 “여기 잘생긴 오빠들 많아요”라고 발언한 데 대해 ‘여학생들을 배려한 것’이라는 취지로 해명하자 정의당이 “내로남불 정치를 더 참아줄 수 없다”고 비판했다. 김 의원을 포함해 국민의힘 쪽에서 이달 초 정청래 더불어민주당 대표와 하정우 민주당 부산 북갑 후보의 ‘오빠’ 발언 논란 당시 두 사람을 거세게 비판하곤 정작 자신들의 ‘오빠’ 발언은 ‘배려’로 포장하려 든다는 것이다.)
